pass_b_english: “The law of the Lord is blameless, converting souls” (Psalm 18:8).

Origen. It is to be asked whether it would convert from vice to virtue, or from the perceptible to the intelligible; and perhaps the second; for the former, the commandment is naturally to make a law, namely the evangelical, as those from the nations having already been educated from the previously mentioned elements, that there is one creator, are taught next also the evangelical law, as it also converted the souls of all the nations into the truth. Because of his boundless love toward us, he passes by neither a fornicator nor a robber, those who have fled his love exceedingly, and have arrived at the extremities of sin.

choices.why: Conversion is from perceptible to intelligible, not only from vice to virtue. The commandment makes the evangelical law.
